Test GAS protection and survival through opening burst and the post-clone transition. Battle date, attempt state, omicrons, datacrons, mods and relics unknown. Uses 501st; conserves a GL.

Provisional, low confidence: same defending members under Malgus lead only. SEE leader with Wat; third slot intentionally empty. Test shield tech, Link and survival to ultimate under DR Ferocity/speed. Do not inherit Malgus-lead rates or omit his nonleader abilities. Ultimate and Wat bonus-turn upgrade required for this test. Datacrons, defensive omicrons, mods and relics unknown. Uses SEE/Wat; preserves Bane.

Provisional, low confidence: same members under Malgus lead only. Test Daka/Zombie survival and revive cycle while SLKR scales to ultimate.
